text: Peer messages are shape-checked, size-capped, clamped and rate limited; blocked players are ignored; peer text is never parsed as HTML.
When matchmaking relays are unreachable the game says so clearly and single player keeps working.
The friends panel and multiplayer HUD fit tablets and phones without overflow, with a hold-to-talk button for touch.
Room and device sync codes carry 80 random bits from the crypto source and shorter codes are refused, so a room cannot be found by reversing its public relay topic.
A peer that never announces itself gets only our hello: no position, chat, ping, match message or microphone until its first valid hi, when it appears in the roster.

A blocked player stays blocked when either side reloads: blocks are kept on the device and matched by a stable per-install id the peer sends in its hi, before any greeting, microphone or position goes to them.
Pilot names that only look alike (Cyrillic or Greek letters, math or fullwidth forms, I for l, other dashes) count as taken, so the newcomer is shown with an id suffix like an exact copy.
The delayed close after a finished device sync only closes that sync, so a new offer made right after it stays reachable.
Friends and their pings keep a tag with the distance at any range (pinned to the screen edge when off screen), and Fly to tracks the friend's live position until another waypoint replaces it.
